description: Na₂Pd(NO₂)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.74 Å. Pd is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Pd-N bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.08 Å. There are four inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Pd and two O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.25 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Pd and two O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.25 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Pd and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.25 Å) and one longer (1.26 Å) N-O bond length. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Pd and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.25 Å) and one longer (1.26 Å) N-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one N atom.
